mapper.update: UPDATE document d SET image_count = #{images}, largest_table_rows = #{largestTableRows}, total_chars = s.total_chars, blank_chars = s.blank_chars, garbled_chars = s.garbled_chars, heading_depth = s.heading_depth FROM (SELECT sum(length(c.content)) AS total_chars, sum(length(c.content) - length(regexp_replace(c.content, '\s', '', 'g'))) AS blank_chars, sum(length(c.content) - length(regexp_replace(c.content, '[\uFFFD\uE000-\uF8FF\u0001-\u0008\u000B\u000C\u000E-\u001F]', '', 'g'))) AS garbled_chars, max(length(c.heading_path) - length(replace(c.heading_path, ' > ', ''))) / 3 AS heading_depth FROM chunk c WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.document_id = #{documentId}) s WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.id = #{documentId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM document_overlap WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (document_id = #{documentId} OR other_document_id = #{documentId})
mapper.insert: WITH mine AS (SELECT DISTINCT md5(content) AS hash FROM chunk WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND document_id = #{documentId}), shared AS (SELECT c.document_id AS other_document_id, count(DISTINCT md5(c.content)) AS n FROM chunk c JOIN mine ON md5(c.content) = mine.hash WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.document_id <> #{documentId} GROUP BY c.document_id), totals AS (SELECT document_id, count(DISTINCT md5(content)) AS total FROM chunk WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (document_id = #{documentId} OR document_id IN (SELECT other_document_id FROM shared)) GROUP BY document_id) INSERT INTO document_overlap (tenant_id, document_id, other_document_id) SELECT #{tenantId}, #{documentId}, s.other_document_id FROM shared s JOIN totals t ON t.document_id = #{documentId} WHERE s.n >= 0.8 * t.total UNION ALL SELECT #{tenantId}, s.other_document_id, #{documentId} FROM shared s JOIN totals t ON t.document_id = s.other_document_id WHERE s.n >= 0.8 * t.total
